answer: A newcomer earns standing only by tending a garden plot for a season: upkeep jobs are logged publicly, each marked with a pigment code tied to one key and countersigned within three days by two neighbours who inspected the work. Unsigned entries expire; reused work or a repeated code strips every linked account of garden access for a year. One honest newcomer tends one plot, while a thousand fakes need a thousand inspected seasons, and a comet burst of fresh accounts with no tended history earns nothing, since standing grows from witnessed upkeep, not account count.
